method: Read-only bind-mount overlay of current controller.py and roundrobin_router.py into the stale image; no image rebuild or system-wide installation.
observations: The first harness attempt supplied a host-only model path. Backend initialization failed because that path did not exist inside the worker container.
Deleting that failed-start router exercised current controller cleanup and killed the named router actor.

The failed backend actor had already reserved one logical Ray GPU resource outside the ready_inference_instances set. Current RoundRobinRouter.shutdown only enumerated ready_inference_instances, so the scheduler remained at 1.0/1.0 GPU until the orphan named backend actor was explicitly killed for cleanup.

A second attempt used the correct /host-models path but could not allocate a backend because of that stale logical reservation; it therefore did not reach inference or physical-GPU reclaim verification.

The existing old-image 6171 MiB leak remains attributable to stale installed delete code. This overlay run additionally reveals that current cleanup is not proven for a backend initialization failure/startup race.
claim_scope: Current source cleanup is partially validated but not publication-ranked. A fresh rebuilt stack must pass successful register/infer/delete/actor-death/scheduler-deallocation/physical-reclaim/re-register, plus a failed-start cleanup regression, before inclusion.
